name: OpenCTI
description: OpenCTI is an open-source Cyber Threat Intelligence platform developed by Filigran in France. It structures threat data using STIX 2 standards with MITRE ATT&CK integration, enabling security teams to manage and share intelligence on adversaries, campaigns, and indicators of compromise.

owner.name: Filigran
owner.description: French cybersecurity company developing open-source threat intelligence and crisis management platforms.
